questions.text: uranium-235 undergoes fission in a reaction shown below, releasing $195\ \mathrm{mev}$ of energy. the binding energy per nucleon for uranium-235 is $7.6\ \mathrm{mev}$ and those for caesium (cs-143) and rubidium (rb-90) are approximately $x\ \mathrm{mev}$. $\vphantom{u}{}^{235}_{92}\mathrm{u}+{}^{1}_{0}\mathrm{n}\rightarrow{}^{143}_{55}\mathrm{cs}+{}^{90}_{37}\mathrm{rb}+3\,{}^{1}_{0}\mathrm{n}$ what is the value of $x$? a 6.8 b 7.6 c 8.0 d 8.5
